description: Renaming the finite free context of an infinitary formula preserves satisfaction when the assignment is pulled back along that same renaming map.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.realize_relabel.{u, v, w, w', z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  {β : Type w'} [Finite α] [Finite β] {n : ℕ} {M : Type z} [L.Structure M] (f : α → β)
  (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula L α n) (a : β → M) (b : Fin n → M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula.relabel f φ) a b ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize φ (a ∘ f) b
